reference_sql:
WITH halves AS (  -- one row per product, with its half of its category by unit cost
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         NTILE(2) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id) AS cost_half
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM halves
WHERE cost_half = 1

WITH halves AS (  -- one row per product, with its half of its category by unit cost
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         NTILE(2) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur ASC, product_id ASC) AS cost_half
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM halves
WHERE cost_half < 2
